title: A Class Looks Back: Our First Month · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
英语中表示过去的状态，用was/were。I/he/she/it用was，you/we/they用were。否定在was/were后加not，如was not (wasn't), were not (weren't)。表示计划或打算做某事，用be going to + 动词原形，如I am going to study. 表示原因用because，后面接句子。

The classroom was small. We were not happy. We are going to use the library room because it is nice.
